## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sahetukaduka* (Patthana 14.2) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* (*patthana*) section of the Pali Tipiṭaka. It constitutes the dyad (*duka*) dealing with states "accompanied by root, and unaccompanied by root" (*sahetuka* and *ahetuka*) within the systematic exposition of conditional relations in the *Duka-Paṭṭhāna* [Nyanatiloka 2007a; Nyanatiloka 2007b].

**Sources**

- [Nyanatiloka 2007a] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Pitaka & Paticca-Samuppada (2007) — Translates the dyad title as 'accompanied by root, and unaccompanied by root'.
- [Nyanatiloka 2007b] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Pitaka (2007) — Places the Sahetuka-duka in the Duka-Paṭṭhāna classification scheme.
